1.explanation:
In this example we’ve added a new prop called `legendId` to both `FormGroup` and `RadioButtonGroup`. When you pass `legendId`, the component should render:

• A `<legend id={legendId}>…</legend>` element
• A `<fieldset aria-labelledby={legendId}>…</fieldset>` wrapper

This code reproduces the desired markup (as shown in the screenshot) and demonstrates the minimal usage pattern for screen-reader–friendly groups of controls. If you inspect the DOM after rendering, you’ll see the `<fieldset>` and `<legend>` correctly linked via `aria-labelledby` and `id`. Ensure your patched components map the `legendId` prop onto both the `legend` and `fieldset` elements.
1.bug_scenario:
In the settings menu example we have a group of radio buttons inside a Carbon `RadioButtonGroup`. We want the rendered HTML to hook the `<legend>` (the visible group label) to the `<fieldset>` via `aria-labelledby`. In other words, we need to supply a custom `id` on the `<legend>` and have the fieldset automatically set `aria-labelledby` to that same id. In the screenshot you can see the desired output:

  <fieldset aria-labelledby="row-height-label">
    <legend id="row-height-label">Row height</legend>
    <!-- radio buttons -->
  </fieldset>

Currently the library doesn’t allow passing an `id` onto the legend, so you either get no `aria-labelledby` on the fieldset, or the two elements can’t be tied together.
